Así quedó el ranking de público del fútbol chileno 2025 |trans-title= |language=es|publisher=Bolavip.cl|date=13 December 2025|access-date=19 January 2026}} |average attendance=7,332 |prevseason= [[2024 Chilean Primera División|2024]] |nextseason= [[2026 Liga de Primera|2026]] }} The '''2025 Liga de Primera''', known as '''Liga de Primera Itaú 2025''' for sponsorship purposes,{{cite web |url=https://redgol.cl/campeonato-nacional/el-campeonato-nacional-del-futbol-chileno-cambia-de-nombre-y-logo |title=Una nueva era: El Campeonato Nacional del fútbol chileno cambia de nombre y logo para el 2025 |trans-title=A new era: the Chilean football's Campeonato Nacional changes name and logo for 2025 |language=es |publisher=RedGol |date=26 January 2025 |access-date=4 February 2025}} was the 95th season of the [[Liga de Primera]], [[Chile]]'s top-flight football league. The season began on 14 February and ended on 7 December 2025.{{cite web |url=https://www.adnradio.cl/2024/11/18/calendario-del-futbol-chileno-cuando-comenzaria-el-campeonato-nacional-2025/ |title=Calendario del fútbol chileno: ¿cuándo comenzaría el Campeonato Nacional 2025? |trans-title=Chilean football's calendar: when would the 2025 Campeonato Nacional start? |language=es |publisher=[[ADN Radio Chile|ADN Radio]] |date=18 November 2024 |access-date=21 November 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.anfp.cl/institucional/hay-fixture-del-campeonato-itau-2025/ |title=¡Hay Fixture del Campeonato Itaú 2025! |trans-title=There is the 2025 Campeonato Itaú's Fixture! |language=es |publisher=[[Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional|ANFP]] |date=20 January 2025 |access-date=20 January 2025}} [[Coquimbo Unido]] were the champions, winning their first Primera División title in this season. They clinched the championship with four matches to go after defeating [[Unión La Calera]] 2–0 on 2 November 2025.{{cite web |url=https://www.latercera.com/el-deportivo/noticia/el-tesoro-mas-grande-de-los-piratas-coquimbo-unido-es-el-campeon-del-futbol-chileno-por-primera-vez-en-su-historia/ |title=El tesoro más grande de los piratas: Coquimbo Unido es el campeón del fútbol chileno por primera vez en su historia |trans-title=The greatest treasure of pirates: Coquimbo Unido are the champions of Chilean football for the first time in their history |language=es |publisher=[[La Tercera]] |date=2 November 2025 |access-date=2 November 2025}} [[Colo-Colo]] were the defending champions. ==Teams== {{location map+ |Chile |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2025 Liga de Primera teams. |places= {{location map~ |Chile |lat=-26.25 |long=-69.616667 |label=

La Serena secured promotion to the top tier after two years on 29 September 2024, winning the Primera B tournament with a 1–0 win over Deportes Recoleta.{{cite web |url=https://www.adnradio.cl/2024/09/29/fiesta-en-la-portada-deportes-la-serena-vence-a-recoleta-grita-campeon-y-logra-su-ascenso-a-primera-division/|title=Fiesta en La Portada: Deportes La Serena vence a Recoleta, grita campeón y logra su ascenso a Primera División|trans-title=Party at La Portada: Deportes La Serena beat Recoleta, shout champion, and clinch their promotion to Primera División|language=es|publisher=ADN Radio|date=29 September 2024|access-date=21 November 2024}} Meanwhile, Deportes Limache achieved a first-ever promotion to Primera División on 7 December 2024, after defeating Rangers on penalties in the promotion play-offs finals.{{cite web |url=https://www.alairelibre.cl/noticias/deportes/futbol/primera-b/limache-y-un-ascenso-historico-a-la-primera-division-en-una-final/2024-12-07/193210.html|title=Limache y un ascenso histórico a la Primera División en una final inolvidable con Rangers|trans-title=Limache and a historical promotion to Primera División in an unforgettable final against Rangers|language=es|publisher=Al Aire Libre|date=7 December 2024|access-date=7 December 2024}} The promoted teams replaced [[C.D.
